Investing in tech founders who build European resilience, security, and insurance.

Backed by incumbents & insurtech builders:
Purpose

The next great societal challenge is to build resilience. Each year, cybercrime and natural catastrophes alone drain $1 trillion from the global economy. Add to that AI-driven fraud, rising health span challenges, and the shift to electric mobility, and the costs of unknown risks are multiplying fast.

As insurers pull back to limit their exposure, vast market gaps emerge—opening opportunities for entrepreneurs building the European sectors of resilience, security, and insurance that the future demands.

This is where we put capital to work.

People
Florian Graillot

Founding Partner

With over 15 years of experience in venture capital and insurtech investments, Florian is recognized as one of the most influential voices in the global insurtech community. His insights reach more than 76,000 insurance professionals each week.

He began his career at The Boston Consulting Group, held key investment roles at Affine and Newfund, and went on to establish AXA Strategic Ventures. Florian holds an engineering degree from Telecom ParisTech and a master's in entrepreneurship from HEC Paris.

Based in Montmartre, Paris, Florian is a proud father, an electronic music enthusiast, a modern art aficionado, and an avid follower of geopolitics.

Jan Kastory

Founding Partner

Jan has spent over a decade at the intersection of finance and technology. Before launching astorya.vc, he built the Euler Hermes Digital Agency (now Allianz Trade) into one of the most disruptive innovation teams in trade finance and sureties.

Earlier, he was working in customer research and business development roles at Autenti.com, a SaaS pioneer in digital signatures in Poland, Millward Brown and GE Capital.

Fluent in Polish, English, and French, Jan is based in Warsaw. Outside of work, he is a committed father and husband, Hyrox competitor, windsurfing instructor, alpine skier, and runner.
